title: MV MV plugin for instant message text with a fade-in animation?

posts.author: meatmanuel
posts.body:
Howdy,
This is an odd thing to start off with, but I'm trying to make a game in the engine that doesn't immediately look like it's made in the engine. One of the first things I'd like to tackle on that front is the typewriter text scroll, since I feel like that's pretty standard and characteristic of RPG Maker. Now, I'm aware of the \> text code and various plugins that sort of do instant text, but all of those plugins are on the simpler side and include player-facing options. My game is extremely text-heavy (the entire focus of the game is walking around talking to people) so the thought of slapping in a text code for every line is super daunting. And on the plugin front, I'd rather not give players the ability to mess with how i want my text displayed!
Specifically, what I'm looking for is a plugin which displays all message text in one go with a snappy slide + fade in, sort of like how some games fade in busts, only instead of a bust it's a block of body text. Being able to fiddle with the speed of both the slide and the fade would be ideal, but not necessary so long as it's quick enough by default.
Cheers, and thanks!

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
meatmanuel said:
I feel like that's pretty standard and characteristic of RPG Maker
Click to expand...
That's pretty standard for just about any game that features any sort of dialogue.
In any case, with the feature you're requesting, you might as well just take the window skin, put it in gimp or similar, make a box big as you need it out of it, and just write your text in there.
Then go and use the show/move picture commands instead of message. It can slide and fade. And since you just want all the text to immediately be there, this works perfectly.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm, make the showfast always be true? Then when you start the message or go to new page make the message window _windowContentsSprite.opacity be 0 and then add a method to the message window update that increases that opacity by some number if it's less than 255.
But do you really want your text to slide in? Or you mean the whole window to slide in when you open/close it? Then I guess you can start the window x at minus game screen width and add to the window message open/close to slide it. And also change how fast the "open/close" slide happens. And if you also meant with the opacity the whole window opacity, you can make that change there too.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I think you could get the slide working with logic that looks almost identical to what
@rpgLord69
posted. Instead of modifying
this._windowContentsSprite.opacity
it would modify
this.x
, placing it at
-Graphics.boxWidth
initially (in newPage) and adding a fixed increment until it reaches 0.
Side note: is it really necessary to use
this._windowContentsSprite.opacity
for the fade? I thought
this.opacity
also existed, which seems a bit simpler…
